remarks: Located on a quiet Lower Weston cul-de-sac, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers generous living space, stylish updates, and a seamless indoor-outdoor connection. The first-floor primary suite is a true retreat with a large walk-in closet, updated en-suite bath, and sliding doors that open directly to the backyard. The living room features a wood-burning fireplace and its own backyard access, creating a great flow for everyday living and entertaining. The eat-in kitchen connects seamlessly to the living/dining area, making it easy to cook, gather, and relax. Bathrooms are freshly updated in bright white finishes for a clean, modern feel. Outside, a spacious yard and patio provide space to relax, play, or host friends-all in a private setting close to schools, town, and commuting routes.
